verdict_text: NO. The cast pattern omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight`, so only 6 matrices per layer (96 total) are cast to bfloat16 instead of the required 7 per layer (112), violating Required result clause 1; the 16 `o_proj` weights are left float32. The assert transforms encode the same wrong count (`is: 96`) and the negative-lookahead float32 check also excludes `o_proj` from the intended bfloat16 set, so the plan will not fail loudly as the "exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16" required check demands. Everything else (no deletions, unchanged names, 114-tensor count, `out/T3` sharded safetensors at 256 MiB) matches the spec.
